اعلولوا (form XII)
# اِعْلَوْلَوْا (iʕlawlaw) /iʕ.law.law/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اُعْلُولُوا (uʕlūlū) /uʕ.luː.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اِعْلَوْلُوا (iʕlawlū) /iʕ.law.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
